name: astgl-knowledge
description: Search and cite As The Geek Learns articles on MCP servers, local AI, and AI automation. Ships a pre-embedded knowledge base — no local model required.
long_description: A local MCP server over the As The Geek Learns corpus: 178 pages covering MCP server design, local LLM workflows on Apple Silicon, and AI automation patterns. Vector search runs against embeddings pre-computed and shipped inside the bundle, so no embedding model or API key is needed to query it. A plain-SQL metadata path (find_articles, list_tags) keeps working even when vector search is unavailable. Anonymous use is limited to 50 queries/day; calling the `register` tool with an email returns a key that raises the limit to 500/day.

astgl_api_key.title: ASTGL API key
astgl_api_key.description: Optional. Raises your limit from 50 to 500 queries/day. Get one by calling the `register` tool with your email address.
